entities.summary: Darlan Ferreira Souza is a Brazilian volleyball player who plays for the Brazilian men's national volleyball team. He represented Brazil at the 2022 FIVB World Championship, where he won a bronze medal. He has emerged as a top playmaker and leader of the Brazilian team.
